title: Homepage status
description: The homepage status file at src/data/now.json. Agents rewrite this file. Directions /a, /b, and /c all read it, so the comparison stays fair. Keep claims factual. Prefix anything that is not a confirmed fact with [Sample]. Do not add employers, metrics, quotations, or accomplishments.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema. Editors and agents use it. The site does not render it.

intro.description: One dry, specific line about who she is. It may contain more than one sentence. Not a headline, a title list, or a mission statement.

activity.description: What she is in the middle of right now. Specific and current. Not a pitch.

where.description: Where that work is happening. If the place is not a confirmed fact, keep the [Sample] prefix.

lastSeenBuilding.description: The last-seen-building line, as a complete sentence. Direction B uses this as the single sentence under the picture.

visual.description: The one live picture at the top of the homepage, kept current by agents. It should read as Lexi and her agents, not as a diagram.

src.description: Site path served from public/ (start with /) or an absolute URL. Replace the file and update this path together.

alt.description: What is actually in the picture, including that it is a stand-in when it still is.

updated.description: Calendar date this file was last updated, YYYY-MM-DD.

featuredArticle.description: Id of the article to point at. Matches the filename in src/content/articles without .md.
